title: simple, reliable, efficient, and always synced.
body:
I’ve been using google keep for a while now, and it is hands down one of the most efficient and straightforward apps for note taking. 

If you are looking for a no fuss app to jot down ideas and keep them securely stored in the cloud, this is the perfect solution.

I also really appreciate that the developers are consistent with updates and bug fixes. I experienced some minor issues recently, but after sending some feedback, the team resolved the glitches quickly.

Highly recommended for anyone who wants a clean, reliable, and effective way to manage their notes.

title: Keep is my go-to business tool.
body:
I always have Keep open somewhere on my screen for quick notes and reminders.

As an author and illustrator, I need to remember small changes to my illustration while I am working on the text. Zap, I have reminders to change or improve things on pg 20, 45, 83 etc. 
When I have completed the text, resizing or moving it around on the art board, I connect my Wacom tablet and using my Keep notes, I make all my illustrations improvements.

I save my research notes or story ideas in this way, even travel plans for international book events.

Where do I start with Keep? With Lables.

For example, I have a system for hierarching my notes. I use the alphabet a, b, c etc, then a space, then the description of the label.

This allows the Labels I use for a current project to be first in the Labels.

Once I have the Label open, I use many short sets of notes for quick refercing.

The Check boxes are awesome but it would be nice to have a third level of detail. 

I also use Drive for more detail by referencing my Keep notes as the first method of collecting info.

Finally, I used the mic for audio notes, it’s super fast.

Thanks for your amazing product.

Bobbi.

title: Used to be good, now terrible
body:
I used to be a regular user, but throughout the past few updates, Google Keep has become almost entirely unusable. 

- Whenever I open the app, it starts ‘refreshing’ endlessly. 
- Many of the images I have added to notes either do not load or take an eternity to load. 
- It has become impossible to ‘take a quick note’ using Keep. 

I have similar problems in the browser version of Keep, but when I raised these issues with Google, they blamed these problems on Apple. How bizarre. This is not an Apple app, it’s a Google app gone bad.
